newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy to recall 150,000 cars - Transport Min.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy to recall 150,000 cars - Transport Min.

text.p: Japan's Transport Ministry said on Tuesday that Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd would recall 150,149 cars in Japan due to defective parts.
A ministry official said the defects were located in the ignition and the alternator.
The models affected by the recall are the Impreza and Legacy, which were manufactured between September 1993 and January 1996, the officials said.
A Fuji Heavy spokesman said the company was recalling about 20,000 Imprezas and about 130,000 Legacies.

The Fuji Heavy spokesman said some exported Impreza and Legacy models also contained defective parts, although he gave no details as to the number of vehicles or the countries to which they were exported.
"We are considering what measures we should take in the countries we export to, taking their safety standards into consideration," the Fuji Heavy spokesman said.
He said the company was considering offering a service programme in the United States similar to Japan's recall programme, although he declined to elaborate.
Fuji Heavy said in July it had told the Transport Ministry it was recalling 336,384 cars in Japan, including Legacy and Impreza models, to repair a defect that could cause the cars' engines to stall.
